Container.Name: PlexBridge
Container.Overview:
PlexBridge copies watched status, stop time, ratings, and regular playlists from one Plex server to another. Preview shows both sides in one table. Nothing is written until you choose the changes and confirm Apply. Tokens are encrypted with the keys in the appdata folder and are not shown again.
The first account you create is the admin, and further sign-ups stay closed. On an empty appdata folder the database is created and migrated at startup, then the register page is the first thing you see.
Smart playlists, collections, and server settings are not copied. A Plex ratingKey or a file path is not an identity across servers. To reach PlexBridge from outside your network, put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS and WebSockets enabled, and set "Behind a reverse proxy" to true.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex migrate watched ratings playlists two servers media

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the PlexBridge web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database, data-protection keys, and logs. Back this folder up. Losing the keys makes saved Plex tokens unreadable.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID PlexBridge runs as. It owns the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the container clock and log timestamps, for example America/Chicago.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik) handles HTTPS in front of PlexBridge. The proxy must allow WebSockets.
